verdict.rationale: Carta documents an official MCP setup guide for Claude, with pre-built Cap Table and Investors plugins. These give LLMs natural-language access to cap tables, SAFEs, grants, 409A valuations, fund performance, and partner data. missing for 10: details of the MCP endpoint, auth and tool list, documented support for MCP clients other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect to your Carta account using pre-built plugins and access fund performance, cap tables, portfolio financials, partner data, and more.
The Carta Investors plugin gives LLMs access to your fund's data
Access ownership, stakeholder lists, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, 409A valuations, financing history, compensation benchmarks, and more — all with natural language questions.
